import icalendar

cal = icalendar.Calendar()

event.add('description', 'Initial meeting to discuss project scope and deliverables.')

event.add('attendee', attendee)

organizer = icalendar.vCalAddress('MAILTO:alice@example.com')
organizer.params['cn'] = 'Alice'
event.add('organizer', organizer)

cal.add_component(event)

with open('output/Project_Kickoff_Meeting.ics', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(cal.to_ical())

print("Calendar event created successfully!")
"""
